body.message:
We completely understand your situation. However, unfortunately, we are unable to hold the apartment without payment.

As we have already arranged the extension for you, we kindly request you to complete the payment by 2nd October at the latest, as we will be able to keep the extension details updated only until then.

If you wish to extend your stay further, we kindly recommend informing us in advance and making an advance payment to secure the extension while you arrange the remaining balance.

This will help us ensure the apartment remains available for your continued stay.
